_about: Assigned abilities (COMBAT_ENGINE_PLAN.md 3.4a): the non-magical twin of assigned spells. One entry per ability; tools/gen_abilities.js writes the ability_facts_load lookup in web/mygame/scenes/combat_abilities.txt from it. kind is one of attack_variant, action, extra_attack, on_hit_rider, trait. uses is a number per fight, or "unlimited". An extra_attack's weapon is "own" (the body's own weapon: its die, damage type and bonus, a cornered archer's sidearm) or "offhand" (a second weapon, given by damage_dice_sides and damage_type). An action names its range bands (range_min, range_max: 0 Engaged to 3 Long), its chance (1-100) and, for a hit, a condition with its escape_dc and src.

multiattack.name: Multiattack
multiattack.desc: After its first attack, it attacks again with the same weapon: the same die, damage type and attack bonus, without the special move. Melee or ranged.

offhand_knife.name: Off-hand Knife
offhand_knife.desc: After its first attack, a quick stab with a knife in the other hand: a d4 piercing strike at the same attack bonus. (Captain Trent's long blade and knife.)

net.name: Net
net.desc: Thrown instead of an attack, at a target at Close or Mid-Range: an attack roll with the body's own attack bonus against AC. A hit restrains the target (Break Free: a DC 10 Strength check). Once per fight. Not used on a target already restrained.
